newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany welcomes Annan as U.N. head.
newsitem.headline: Germany welcomes Annan as U.N. head.

text.p: Germany, which hopes to win a permanent seat on the Security Council, welcomed on Wednesday the formal appointment of Kofi Annan as the new U.N. secretary-general.
Annan, a 58-year-old U.N. career official from Ghana, was sworn in on Tuesday as secretary-general.
"I offer my heartful congratulations to you for your election as the next secretary-general of the United Nations," German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said in a letter to Annan.
"I am delighted that a person such as yourself, with your enormous experience at the United Nations, will be in the position to do all you can to push forward the reforms of the organisation."
Kohl added: "You can be certain that Germany will actively support you in your efforts."
Annan, who called for the world body to become leaner and more effective, takes over on January 1.
